newsitem.title: GERMANY: Commerzbank plans no capital increase.
newsitem.headline: Commerzbank plans no capital increase.

text.p: Germany's Commerzbank AG said on Tuesday that it did not expect to raise capital in any form for the time being.
"We do not expect to raise capital on the market for the time being," chief executive Martin Kohlhaussen told a news conference, adding that no other form of capital-raising was planned either.
Kohlhaussen said the bank's transfer-to-reserves from its 1996 profit would at least match the 1996 dividend pay-out and added he hoped the transfer would be a little bit more than the pay-out.
Kohlhaussen was quoted in a newspaper interview last week as saying that the bank planned no increase on its 1995 dividend of 13.05 marks per share.
